description: Elections Commission - J. N. Peiris, K. K. I. R. Perera and L. K. C. Perera of the Panadura Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated Office of Member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as Members of the Panadura Pradeshiya Sabha due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including declarations about candidate/member status.
